tools.name: basic_lookup
tools.description: Short public company brief: what the company does, industry, headquarters and key facts, from Wikipedia and the company's public homepage, each with a source URL. Not a verified contact or CRM record. Price: $0.10 USDC on Base per call via x402; this MCP call returns payment instructions and the pai

tools.name: enriched_lookup
tools.description: Richer public company record for prospecting: description, industry, size signals, products, public website summary and sources. Use after basic_lookup when you need more context. Not a CRM row or verified email. Price: $0.75 USDC on Base per call via x402; this MCP call returns payment instructions

tools.name: prospect_brief
tools.description: Full sales prospect brief for one company: overview, positioning, likely needs and talking points, built from public sources with URLs. Price: $3.00 USDC on Base per call via x402; this MCP call returns payment instructions and the paid HTTP route POST /v1/deep returns the brief. Read-only.

tools.name: run_named_tool
tools.description: Run one named public-source analysis: research_company, research_person, find_decision_makers, analyze_marketing_opportunity, identify_buying_signals, enrich_prospect, score_prospect or generate_prospect_brief. Fields with no verified public source come back as unknown rather than guessed. Price: $0

tools.name: email_lookup
tools.description: Find one person's work email at a company domain. Returns the address, whether it was found publicly or inferred from the company's pattern, Hunter's real verification status (valid, accept_all, unknown, invalid), a confidence score, the pages it was seen on and a recommendation. Price: $0.08 USDC o

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: basic_lookup, enriched_lookup, prospect_brief, run_named_tool, email_lookup · Private data: basic_lookup, enriched_lookup · Public sink: basic_lookup, enriched_lookup, prospect_brief, run_named_tool, email_lookup · Destructive: run_named_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: basic_lookup, enriched_lookup, prospect_brief, run_named_tool, email_lookup · Private data: basic_lookup, enriched_lookup · Public sink: basic_lookup, enriched_lookup, prospect_brief, run_named_tool, email_lookup · Destructive: run_named_tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
